opinions: MILITARY ACTION DEFYING INTERNATIONAL LAW IS RARELY JUSTIFIED AND UNDERMINES GLOBAL STABILITY.

ACCESS TO HIGHER STANDARDS OF MEDICAL CARE SHOULD BE BASED ON NEED, NOT THE ABILITY TO PAY.

PROTECTIONISM CAN BE NECESSARY TO SAFEGUARD LOCAL INDUSTRIES AND WORKERS.
